import { A, useLocation, useRouter } from "@shadow-js/router";

export function Nav() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const pathname = useLocation().pathname;
  return (
    <nav>
      <A href="/" preload={false}>Home</A>
      <A href="/docs" class="nav">Docs</A>
      <button type="button" onClick={() => router.navigate("/login")}>Log in</button>
      <button type="button" onClick={() => router.navigate("/", { replace: true })}>Home</button>
      <button type="button" onClick={() => router.history.back()}>Back</button>
      <button type="button" onClick={() => router.invalidate()}>Reload {pathname}</button>
      <button type="button" onMouseEnter={() => router.preload("/docs")}>Docs</button>
    </nav>
  );
}
